text: Psalm 93 The Lord reigns; He is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed; He has put on strength as His belt. Indeed, the world is established; it cannot be moved.
Your throne is established of old; You are from everlasting.
The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring waves.
The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yes, than the mighty waves of the sea.
Your statutes are very sure; holiness is becoming to Your house, O Lord, forever.
